classification.difficultyReason: Match corresponding sides across differently oriented and nested similar figures, then calculate an unknown length.

content.prompt: The diagram in each part shows two figures that are known to be similar. Write a ratio statement. Hence find the value of the pronumeral.

spec.description: Paired right triangles retain opposite orientations, vertex labels, both right-angle squares and corresponding single-marked acute angles. Ordinary source blue outlines become house black.
spec.mathematics: AB=5, AC=6, DE=x, DF=2; B and E are right angles; C corresponds to F.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied givens are visible; the value of x is absent.

answer.worked:
Matching sides of similar triangles are proportional.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{5}&=\frac{2}{6}\\x&=5\times\frac{2}{6}\\x&=\frac{5}{3}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upright PQR and inverted XYZ remain paired. PQR has double equal-side ticks, XYZ single equal-side ticks, and P and Z carry matching angle marks. Ordinary source blue outlines become house black.
spec.mathematics: PQ=PR=5, QR=x, XY=2, XZ=YZ=3; P corresponds to Z.
spec.answerVisibility: All supplied givens are visible; the value of x is absent.

answer.worked:
The bases correspond, and a side of length $5$ corresponds to a side of length $3$.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{2}&=\frac{5}{3}\\x&=2\times\frac{5}{3}\\x&=\frac{10}{3}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Two quadrilaterals remain paired horizontally with the second rotated relative to the first. Both pairs of right-angle marks and the matching acute-angle marks remain visible. Ordinary source blue outlines become house black.
spec.mathematics: The first figure's top side 3 corresponds to the second figure's left side 6; its side x corresponds to the second figure's bottom side 3. The second figure also retains the redundant side length 10.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied dimensions and marks are visible.

answer.worked:
Match sides using the right angles and the marked acute angles.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{3}&=\frac{3}{6}\\x&=3\times\frac{3}{6}\\x&=\frac{3}{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: The smaller parallelogram shares the large parallelogram's bottom-right vertex and portions of its lower and right sides. Single horizontal and double sloping parallel marks are retained. Ordinary source blue outlines become house black.
spec.mathematics: Large parallelogram base 8 and side x correspond to small parallelogram base 3 and side 2.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied dimensions and parallel marks are visible.

answer.worked:
Corresponding sides of the similar parallelograms are proportional.

$$\begin{align*}\frac{x}{2}&=\frac{8}{3}\\x&=2\times\frac{8}{3}\\x&=\frac{16}{3}\end{align*}$$
